runtime_choices.contract: Original 21 quota array; thereafter round(232000*1.2^(round-21)); success does not reduce anger; after a survivable day21 settlement the contract clears even if that payment is incomplete.
runtime_choices.money: Nonnegative monetary inputs, integer rounding away from zero, explicit 1e100 saturation including positive overflow; NaN/negative rejected.
runtime_choices.relic_shop: Corrected original eight-entry starter pool randomly offers three/take-one; paid draws use original rarity curve/weights and remove owned/disabled/day-locked/achievement-locked entries. No early safety shelf or fixed choice.
runtime_choices.merchant: Original base-quota price formulas, ceil-to-ten first quote, repeat price x3; original visit schedule/basic/special stock. Seven original item definitions are inspectable, six enabled because rewind is deferred. Five removed tools and restore cards are not offered.
runtime_choices.supply: Three original ordinary deliveries, +1 Supply Permit, plus pending extra supply; Life Contract sets minimum7; passed Badge minimum2; passed Testament first-sword floor(30% best delivered grade); combine grade minimums using maximum.
runtime_choices.ordinary_families: Three lanes/two branches: citadel/holy, sawblade/dragonfang, runeblade/splitblade; Session assigns delivered sword lane i%3 using OrdinaryFamily. Merchant special families are world-tree/fishblade/funerary.
runtime_choices.progression: Exactly 19 original achievements and 16 corresponding relic unlocks. Mastery requires current surviving grade20, not only PeakGrade. No MOBILE80/99 awards, career cosmetics or stat bonuses. Art discovery keys retain current original presentation identity only.
runtime_choices.state: Small Profile/Run/State/Result data roots authored from necessary fields. Profile slots2..8 and Run ward entitlement remain separate. State schema1 and minimal-v1. Optional-presence flags and reward receipt extensions belong to separate root-owned partial files.
runtime_choices.pending_break: EventId/SwordId/PreSword/PostSword/PostContext/Result only. Session retains pre-loss Context until loss acceptance, while result RNG already advanced. This is a confirmation/one-time-loss boundary, with no recovery API or replay.
runtime_choices.physical_delivery: Original requires-empty-hands metadata retained on both sword offers. Approved mobile adaptation delivers directly into the cabinet without imposing Swords.Count==0/SelectedSword==null, and without changing supply quantity or price.

integration_contract.economy_queries: EvaluateTribute and SupplyForNextRound do not mutate input state. Session applies returned changes once in its Commit. Generators mutate only their explicit ref shopRng and return new offer lists.
integration_contract.new_round: Set Context.Round; reset PaidRerolls/VoucherUsed/HookUsed/AnyReroll and Context.InsuranceUsed/FuneralClaims. Consume Context.NextSupply once after planned supply allocation. Supply/merchant bonuses apply at the next generation, not immediately on relic purchase.
integration_contract.progression_observers: Award/Observe only mutate passed permanent fact collections (and best/discovery observations), never IO/RNG/economic balances. Call them inside the same Session commit.
integration_contract.counter_order: Session increments actual break/frenzy counters first, then ObserveBreak/Frenzy. Apply ExtendedPaymentsGain first, then ObserveTribute. ObserveClear does not increment Profile.Completed. IsMerchantSoldOut requires all units of a nonempty visit; then caller invokes ObserveSoldOut.
integration_contract.equipment_capacity: Hard maximum8 differs from current Profile.UnlockedRelicSlots2..8; Session equip commands enforce actual capacity. These economy generators never grant capacity or advertisements.
integration_contract.standalone_check: Compile Tests/Headless/EconomyChecks.cs with ECONOMY_CHECKS_STANDALONE, seven Gameplay source files and the test-only UnityDataShim. Pass repository Assets/Resources. For aggregation call EconomyChecks.Run() after assigning the test Resources root.
integration_contract.royal_credit_timing: Current RoyalCredit belongs to the current quota. Day21 clear_offer stores the newly calculated credit in Run.NextRoyalCredit until extended play actually starts; it must not invalidate the still-current day21 Quota.

known_differences_and_unknowns: The researched website is not an independently verified Steam executable; deterministic local draws and tables do not establish native-game RNG parity.
Raw site snapshots still contain loop in the starter pool. Runtime uses the already approved October7 correction loop→shard recorded in current rule-data.json.

Original rewind remains unresolved/deferred. Day3 therefore generates three offers (two swords+ward), rather than the original four, and later pool/RNG trajectories and sold-out difficulty also differ. No restore substitute is added.

Exact combined Royal Change/rebate integer order and whether merchant/reroll quotes use base or effective quota are unresolved in the original evidence. This module preserves the existing audited C# choice: round rebate, cap credit at30% of discounted quota; quotes use base quota.

Merchant pool retries and final marginal offer probability remain uncertain in source evidence. This module reuses the explicit audited local remove-then-22%-gate selection, without claiming exact original generator equivalence.
Direct cabinet delivery is an approved physical-interaction adaptation; RequiresEmptyHands is metadata, not an all-inventory-empty rule.
Headless DTO round-trip uses the test JSON shim, not native Unity null/presence verification. New SaveStore owns explicit presence bits and transactions.
This check does not validate complete Session resource consistency, persistence failures, earned ad handling, target devices, complete ordered effects or long-run commercial balance.
